title: Entities & Damages — Handling No Loss Location Selected
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — seeds a policy with no loss location (lossLocation.locations = [])
Observe: page loads, entity table renders, Limit column shows single-value string (not multi-limit list)
Open any entity detail panel — Limit field shows single string, no crash

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Given no loss location was selected, when Entities & Damages loads, then no location group or limits section is shown and no error occurs.
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When `lossLocation.locations` is empty, the Entities & Damages page loads without error. The Limit column shows the plain string value (`entity.limit`) rather than the per-location multi-limit list. No location group header or limit breakdown section is rendered.

setup.description: Seed a policy with no loss location selected. Only fnolStateOverride.selectedPolicy is set so the page doesn't redirect to /fnol/search. lossLocation defaults to { locations: [] } on reset — no additional override needed.

preconditions.text: lossLocation is empty (no locations selected in step-loss-information)
Entities & Damages page loads without error — no blank screen, no console crash
Limit column shows plain string (e.g. '500,000 EUR') not a multi-row breakdown list

expectedUI.description: Entity table renders normally. The Limit column for ENT-001 (Kaufmann's Warehouse) shows '500,000 EUR' as a single string — not the 3-row Building / Contents / Business interruption breakdown.
visualCues: Entities & Damages page visible with entity table
No console error or blank-page crash
Limit column: single plain text value, no ul/li limit breakdown
Entity detail panel (side sheet): Limit info-field shows single string

howToTest.expectedResult: Page loads, entity table renders, Limit column shows plain string — no multi-limit list, no error
